hints.title: Dual Parity Templates
hints.text: There are only two possible alternating parity sequences for an array: even-starting or odd-starting.

hints.title: Discrepancy Counting
hints.text: Count how many elements deviate from the expected parity under both template patterns.

hints.title: Minimal Deviation
hints.text: The minimum number of modifications is the lesser of the two mismatch totals.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass comparing parity with dual target templates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of changes requires exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that only 2 canonical target patterns exist.
